summary: Owner renewed the Agrippa/Münchhausen challenge to explanatory regress. Materialized/read the complete pinned Latta Monadology §§31–45, separating §32 universal explanatory scope and epistemic limitation, §§33–35 analytical termination, §§36–37 renewed contingent-detail demand and §45 proposed intrinsic existence reason. Existing unique-feedback, history-contrastive and regress fixed-point certificates already cover the formal omission tests; no duplicate theorem or opaque adequacy predicate is added. Leibniz argues against leaving the whole contingent sequence explained only by further contingent details, not against infinity as a cardinal or against every beginningless history. The independently disputed premises are whole-series PSR, the inadequacy of an undischarged contingent explanation-base, and the exclusion of intrinsic global/non-well-founded accounts. A brute global fact, a proposed global-structural account and a non-well-founded ground account are separate proposed rivals; no completed adequate ontic explanation is certified by the feedback control. Neither necessity nor a reason-token alone certifies the proposed necessary ground’s sufficiency. See the explanatory-adequacy audit in docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md for exact argument steps, theorem locators, rejected readings and remaining bridges. Intended/actual root-premise delta zero; no premise established, no source-free per se causal impossibility inferred. Follow-up positive-rival reading: read the complete official CC BY Welchance 2026 PDF (pp.1–21), with WELCHANCE-INFINITISM-1-3 now materializing pp.1–18. Common explanatory theory across existence facts is a positive defeasible virtue; parity permits local explanatory use of an unexplained chain just as an unexplained foundation. The source expressly does not establish actual infinitism or a completed totality explanation. The existing note now audits fact versus being relata, plural full versus binary partial grounds, ordinary examples, exclusions, structural-property justification, and abstraction to direct existential support. Rejected: parity as total-PSR satisfaction, generic grounding as conservation R, or formal acyclicity as adequacy. Bohn publisher metadata corrects the title to Indefinitely Descending Ground; BOHIDG and BOHIDGv1 fetches returned 403 and the author-linked NVA record was inaccessible. No chapter attribution is made. Remaining bridge: an independently defended intrinsic sufficient existence reason versus uniformity/parity under the same explanatory scope. Root delta remains zero; no new theorem/claim or philosophical vocabulary. Owner follow-up: reused #669 Klein–Turri finite-performance/available-reasons distinction without new sourcing. Finite inquiry may answer local challenges only under a defended truth-conducive adequacy norm; ontic grounds need not be traversed by thinkers. Added the exact order/rule burden: distinguish full joint ground from a partial arrow and defend obtaining, direction and rule application rather than enumeration, mutual entailment or recursive description. Welchance §1.3 n.15 leaves the further explanatory-link strategy undeveloped. Any rule being question-able does not alone refute it; independent warrant versus merely borrowed support is the issue. Recorded strongest conditional Occam argument: prefer an equally adequate account with fewer gratuitous independent commitments, comparing entity cardinality, kinds/laws, unexplained assumptions and specification length separately. Neither infinite members as infinite independent costs nor finite compression as adequate explanation is assumed. No new independent philosophical premise is defended; root delta zero. Extraction repair: full-PDF bytes unchanged; a bounded Poppler26.01.0 versus Ubuntu:noble24.02.0 comparison isolated CI text-hash drift to zero-width characters in the p.19 CC-license URL only. Materialized selection narrowed to pp.1–18, with identical cross-version text, retaining full-PDF raw hash and complete consulted context. No integrity gate or dependency change. Follow-up independently materialized/read Spinoza Elwes I definitions1–8, axioms1–7, propositions1–11 with I8 notes and all I11 proofs/note, and reread Aquinas q3a4/q44a1 and Monadology31–45. Positive intrinsic-nature reply and symmetric individual-adequacy constraint persist in docs/psr-scope-countermodels.md, Intrinsic existence reasons: I8 noteII and I11 triangle contrasts require explanation of individual existence/multiplicity rather than generic essential properties. Distinguished actual-witness presupposition from a fresh existence proof, and causa sui from efficient self-production. I7 needs explanatory exhaustiveness; I11 additionally owes internal consistency or a reality-to-existence-power bridge. Mathematical essential explanation motivates nonproductive reasons without establishing concrete instantiation. Foundation and global infinitist rivals both owe an independently characterized real nature/structure that explains actuality; neither bare necessity nor local dependency assignments discharge that debt. No new attribution record or formal adequacy flag; root delta zero.
